title: Outbox
subtitle: Automatic sends wait here before they leave. Review, edit or cancel one while it waits.
error.load: Boba could not read the Outbox.
empty.title: Nothing is waiting
empty.body: When an automatic send is about to go out, it waits here first and Boba lets you know.
notification.title: An application is waiting in the Outbox
notification.body: Boba queued an automatic send. Open the Outbox to review, edit or cancel it before the hold ends.
edit.title: Edit before it sends
edit.subject: Subject
edit.saved: Saved. The send will use your edit.
edit.error: Boba could not save that edit.
hold.title: Outbox hold
hold.label: Hold each automatic send for
hold.error: The hold must be between 5 minutes and 24 hours.
hold.hint: A session board send always waits at least 60 minutes.
dry_run.title: Dry run
dry_run.hint: A new rule only reports its first matches. Nothing is sent until you activate it.
dry_run.complete: Dry run complete — review what it would have sent, then activate the rule.
dry_run.error: Boba could not activate that rule.
note.dry_run_ended: The dry run ended before it was sent. Review and send it yourself if you want to apply.
note.interrupted: Boba closed while this send was about to leave. Check your Sent folder, then apply again if needed.
note.send_failed: The send did not happen. Review it and send it yourself.
note.review: The policy held it back. Review and send it yourself if it still fits.
note.channel_unavailable: Boba does not send on this channel automatically yet. Review it and send it yourself.
note.no_mailbox: Connect a mailbox to send this. Review it meanwhile.
note.kill_switch: The Kill Switch stopped this send. Review it and send it yourself when you turn the switch off.
note.context_missing: Boba could not find this application any more, so it left the Outbox. Nothing was sent.
